name: Bangladesh
summary: Low-lying deltaic nation in South Asia vulnerable to sea-level rise and cyclone surges. Suffers from chronic transboundary and local winter particulate haze across the Ganges-Brahmaputra Delta.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 14.80x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); highest national population-weighted PM2.5 exposure in the world.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; high humidity exacerbates wet-bulb temperature stress during pre-monsoon.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Consistent warming rate across Bengal delta stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.3% share of global fossil emissions; dominated by natural gas and apparel manufacturing power.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Extremely low per capita emissions reflecting high population density and developing industrial base.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Dominated by the coastal Sundarbans mangrove wetland, the world's largest contiguous mangrove ecosystem.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Limited utility renewable penetration; off-grid solar home systems serve rural communities.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: High population density of 1,328 people/km²; one of the most densely inhabited sovereign states.
